description: This file defines a React component named RemindersPanel that manages and displays a list of reminders, including features to add, edit, delete reminders, and show upcoming and past reminders. It imports ReminderForm component and ReminderService for data operations.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of reminders from the ReminderService.

methods.name: askPermission
methods.description: Requests permission from the user to send browser notifications.

methods.name: startCreate
methods.description: Initiates creation of a new reminder with optional prefilled data.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Sets the current editing reminder to allow modifications.

methods.name: closeForm
methods.description: Closes the reminder form modal and resets editing state.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of a reminder, saving it through ReminderService.

methods.name: deleteReminder
methods.description: Deletes a reminder by id through ReminderService.

methods.name: pastsEmpty(arr)
methods.description: Checks if the past reminders list is empty.
